turn_prompts: Generate the task metadata document from the approved task proposal and generated files. Keep identifiers, paths, and declared behavior internally consistent. Do not invent repository URLs or commit IDs: Harbor derives immutable provenance from the frozen source and rejects conflicting supplied values. Produce only the required structured artifact, then invoke the stage-private harbor_submit_stage_output dynamic tool with it. Do not finish with prose alone; only an accepted tool submission is a stage result.
